title: Heating in human-HVAC interaction for smart homes: An interdisciplinary overview
abstract: arXiv:2609.23508v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: As part of HVAC systems, residential heating provides foundational infrastructure for human habitation in cold weather. However, research on how residents interact with HVAC systems, particularly heating systems, remains fragmented across architecture, engineering, informatics, physiology, psychology, sociology, and design. Based on 541 studies from these fields, this review integrates interdisciplinary research on Heating in Human-HVAC Interaction in smart homes.The resulting synthesis is conceptualized through the Situated Interaction Dynamics of control and feedback between users and systems. User-initiated interactions involve monitoring past and present system performance and planning future operation, while system-initiated interactions rely on sensor networks to trigger automation or provide information enabling user action. These interaction dynamics connect Residents' Experience and Practices with Heating in HVAC System Mechan

translated_title: 智能家居中人-HVAC交互中的供暖：一项跨学科综述
translated_abstract: 作为HVAC（供暖、通风与空调）系统的一部分，住宅供暖为寒冷天气中的人类居住提供了基础设施。然而，关于居民如何与HVAC系统（尤其是供暖系统）交互的研究，仍然分散在建筑学、工程学、信息学、生理学、心理学、社会学和设计学等各个领域。基于来自这些领域的541项研究，本综述整合了关于智能家居中人-HVAC交互中供暖的跨学科研究。由此形成的综合框架通过用户与系统之间控制与反馈的“情境化交互动力学”进行概念化。用户发起的交互涉及监测系统过去和现在的性能并规划未来的运行，而系统发起的交互则依靠传感器网络来触发自动化或提供信息以支持用户行动。这些交互动力学将居民的经验与实践同HVAC系统机制中的供暖联系起来……
tldr: 本综述基于541项跨学科研究，提出了一个通过用户与系统之间控制与反馈的情境化交互动力学来理解智能家居中人-HVAC供暖交互的综合框架。
en_tdlr: This review synthesizes 541 interdisciplinary studies into a comprehensive framework that conceptualizes heating in human-HVAC interaction in smart homes through situated interaction dynamics of control and feedback between users and systems.
